instruction: Search for the MambaIR Git repository, download the code as a ZIP file to the NETWORKS folder on the D drive, extract the ZIP file, and open the extracted folder in VSCode
natural_language_task: Can you find the MambaIR repository on GitHub, download it as a ZIP file, save it to my NETWORKS folder on the D drive, extract the files there, and then open the folder in Visual Studio Code so I can work with the code?
actual_task: Search for the MambaIR GitHub repository using a web browser, download the repository code as a ZIP file, specify the save location as D:\NETWORKS folder, extract the ZIP file contents to the same location, and open the extracted MambaIR-main folder in Visual Studio Code, including navigating through file dialogs and confirming security prompts to enable full access to the code.

instruction: Browse and filter information on online bachelor's and master's degrees offered in computer, business, and math-related topics in Coursera.
natural_language_task: Can you help me find and explore online bachelor's and master's degrees in computer science, business, and math on Coursera? I'd like to see what options are available from different universities.
actual_task: Browse Coursera's website to find information about online bachelor's and master's degrees focused on computer science, business, and mathematics. This involved navigating to the online degrees section, scrolling through available programs, attempting to use filtering tools, interacting with the chat assistance feature (repeatedly), and viewing multiple pages of degree offerings from various universities before determining the task was complete.
